title: Baked Devil's Float
instructions: Boil sugar and water together for 10 minutes.
Add dry ingredients, then milk; mix.
Drop batter by spoonfuls into hot syrup.
Let stand several hours before serving.
story: Family lore states that when my grandmother made this recipe she had to make two- one for my grandfather and one for the rest of the family. Note: Like lots of syrup?  Increase ingredients to 1 1/2 cups sugar and 3 cups water.
